description: Main source file for the alerting service API built with FastAPI. Defines API endpoints for health checks, alert creation, listing, and acknowledgment, and includes middleware configuration.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint that returns a simple message indicating the service is healthy.

methods.description: Endpoint to create (persist) a new alert based on provided payload.

methods.name: List[AlertOut] internal_list_alerts( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), user_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional user UUID to filter."), status: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional status filter."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), )

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] internal_ack_alert(alert_id: str)
